points.wrong_point: Memory strip showed Q2FY27 revenue 3,724 Cr / PAT 538 Cr (USD million labelled Rs Cr)
points.evidence: Filing (3-page press release) has no results at all; only 'Consolidated revenues of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion'. Live card memory_context now reads revenue 35,620 Cr / PAT 5,132 Cr, so it has been corrected since review (could not see the reviewed version).
points.catch_reason: The filing is not the source; both engines read the same release.
points.better_check: Carry the currency/unit with every memory fact and refuse USD figures in a Cr slot; sanity-check memory revenue vs market cap/prior quarter.

points.wrong_point: Standalone revenue shown as Rs 3.95 Cr instead of Rs 395.3 Cr (unit fixer divided by 100)
points.evidence: Text layer p11: 'Standalone Financials ... Income ... Rs Cr 380.7 395.3'; p12 has one unrelated 'AUR* (Rs Lakh)' chart (text lines 327,366). Live card now shows 395.3 Cr with unit_fixes null, so already fixed or regenerated (reviewed version not seen). 11 of 31 pages are low-text (charts).
points.catch_reason: Both engines would read '395.3' and '₹ Cr' correctly; the damage was done after extraction by declared_unit.
points.better_check: Never rescale a figure that appears verbatim in the filing next to a Cr label; declared unit must be per page/table, not one 'Lakh' line for the whole deck.

points.wrong_point: Results table EBITDA Rs 2,387 Cr at 14.75% margin (against 2,264 / 14.41% prior quarter): these are EBIT
points.evidence: Call text p10: 'EBIT ... US$250 million with an EBIT margin of 14.8% ... In rupee terms, operating profit stood at INR2,387 crores'. 2,387/16,180 = 14.75%. Live results block now shows EBITDA 2,878.5 (17.79%), so changed since the review (not verifiable).
points.catch_reason: Transcript text is clean; 'operating profit' is a semantic label problem, not a reading problem.
points.better_check: Cross-check: a claimed EBITDA margin that equals the stated EBIT margin (14.8%) is a label error; prefer XBRL/results-statement EBITDA over call prose.

points.wrong_point: 15% FY27 margin target described as set in July (card why_it_matters), memory says April 2026
points.evidence: Card cites g_9deaf301 (given 2026-04-28 per reviewer). Call p11 only says 'we reiterate ... target of 15%'. The grounder flagged 'verified:false' on this takeaway ('20 is not in its quote or the memory it cites').
points.catch_reason: Date comes from memory, not from the filing text.
points.better_check: Render the date from the memory item's own date field instead of letting the writer state it.

points.wrong_point: 'Third straight quarter above US$1 billion' (reviewer: fourth)
points.evidence: Transcript: 'total deal wins for the quarter were US$1.023 billion' and 'new deal wins exceeding $1 billion'; no count of consecutive quarters in the filing. Count not verifiable from filing; memory ref g_9deaf301 does not carry it.
points.catch_reason: The count is not in the PDF at all.
points.better_check: Require a streak claim to be backed by listed memory quarters; recompute the streak in code from stored TCV by quarter.

points.wrong_point: 'Rs 750 issue price is a significant discount to market price of approx Rs 1,000 (based on Rs 15,395 Cr market cap and 17.9 Cr shares)'
points.evidence: One-page letter (Rs 750, Rs 12,794 millions, issue closes 22 Oct) has no market price. Card's own priced_at_filing: last_price 784.8, market_cap 15,395.26. 15,395/17.9 = about 860, so the writer's 1,000 is wrong arithmetic on memory inputs; basis MEMORY with memory_refs empty.
points.catch_reason: Not in the filing; the filing text is trivially clean.
points.better_check: Compute discount in code from last_price (784.8 -> -4.4%); reject MEMORY-basis numeric claims with no memory_refs.

points.wrong_point: Results table: PAT 546.36 vs XBRL comparatives 494.91 / 425.32 and NII 1435.37 / 1498.78 (PAT +10.4% / +28.5%, NII +4.7% / +0.2%), contradicting headline 10.6%
points.evidence: Text layer P&L slide: 'Net Interest Income 1,433.99 1,497.12 1,502.31 4.8% 0.3%'; 'Net Profit 494.11 424.18 546.36 10.6% 28.8%'. Live results block still shows 494.91 / 425.32 / 1435.37 / 1498.78 and yoy 10.4%, qoq 28.5%, so the error is live. The deck text carries no 'standalone' word, so the basis is not stated in the text (consolidated XBRL vs deck basis mismatch).
points.would_dual_engine_catch: no (same-PDF engines); yes for a cross-source check
points.catch_reason: Both engines read the deck's own 494.11 correctly; the wrong priors come from the XBRL source, not from OCR. A second engine on the PDF would not help.
points.better_check: Compare results-block YoY/QoQ with the filing's own printed % (10.6 vs 10.4 and 28.8 vs 28.5 disagree); if XBRL priors differ from the deck's priors by >0.1%, use the deck's or drop the block.

points.wrong_point: Takeaway/why_it_matters: Rs 588.85 Cr proceeds 'fully utilized', 'no unutilized proceeds'
points.evidence: p3 table (clean text): total allocation 588.85, funds utilised total 401.36; 'Funding inorganic growth and strategic initiatives ... 165.00 ... ---' (nothing utilised), setting up branches 38.31 vs 15.82 utilised. 'Nil' deviation (p2) is a different thing from utilisation.
points.catch_reason: All figures are cleanly present in the text; the AI conflated 'no deviation' with 'fully used'.
points.better_check: Code check: sum utilised vs allocated column and reject 'fully utilized' when 401.36 < 588.85; require number-bearing support for 'no unutilized'.

points.wrong_point: Why-it-matters: QC contribution margin 'slipped to -1.0% from -0.2% a year ago'
points.evidence: Text p~5/p~12: 'Contribution margin improved 157bps YoY to reach -1.0% of GOV (-82bps QoQ)'; so -0.2% is Q1FY27. The card's own notable_change quote says 'improved 157bps YoY' while its text says 'previous -0.2% (Q2FY26)'. PDF (40 pages) was truncated by the proxy at 12.9 MB; re-fetched via Range to 17,363,369 bytes.
points.catch_reason: Quote and right figure sit side by side in clean text; the model mislabelled the period and direction.
points.better_check: Check that the card's direction word agrees with the verb in its own quote ('improved' vs 'slipped'); derive previous = current + stated bps change and compare.

points.wrong_point: Results block: adjusted EBITDA -760 vs reported-basis priors -798 / -650, giving LOSS_NARROWED; headline says widened
points.evidence: Filing 5-quarter table: 'Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA -695 -712 -652 -651 -760' and text 'decreased by INR 64 Cr YoY, to a loss of INR 760 Cr' (so prior year 696/695). -798/-650 are not in the deck; they are reported EBITDA from XBRL. Live card still shows -798/-650 and LOSS_NARROWED.
points.catch_reason: Current value from the deck, priors from XBRL on another basis; the deck text is clean and has the right priors.
points.better_check: Same-basis rule (adjusted vs reported); compare the block's YoY direction with the filing's 'decreased by INR 64 Cr' and with the card's own headline verb.

points.wrong_point: Prune dropped a true point (QC loss Rs 895 Cr) because its quote lacked the figure
points.evidence: Filing: 'Adjusted EBITDA losses rose by INR 46 Cr YoY to INR 895 Cr'; '-895' in QC table. Live card's what_happened mentions 895 (QoQ +118), so I cannot tell which dropped point is meant.
points.catch_reason: Quote-contract false negative in code; the text was readable.
points.better_check: Match numbers in a point against the whole page, not only the quote string.

points.wrong_point: Results block revenue Rs 2,540 Cr and EBITDA Rs 420 Cr (stale July-call values stored in memory under Q2FY27); headline/key numbers right
points.evidence: Live results block: revenue 2,540.0 (prior 2,371.84), EBITDA 420.0 while key_numbers say 2,633.2 and 417.8. Filing statement p~30 (INR million): 'Revenue from operations 26,331.80 26,205.51 23,718.44', deck 'EBITDA 4,178 11% 3,748 4,183' (a quarter-end CY label 'Q3 CY26' vs company FY label 'Q2FY27'). Right figure is present in clean text.
points.catch_reason: The wrong values never came from this PDF.
points.better_check: Current-period values in results block must come from this filing (statement or XBRL), never memory; reconcile block with key_numbers.

points.wrong_point: Why-it-matters: memory growth 12-15% seen in Q1-Q2 CY26 turned into FY27 guidance
points.evidence: Card cites g_fbcf2d56; '12-15' is not in the filing text (the only 12% figures are segment growth rows).
points.catch_reason: Claim originates from memory, not the filing.
points.better_check: Require the guidance item's period/type fields to match before a memory item is called 'guided FY27'.

points.wrong_point: Prune dropped a true margin point
points.evidence: Not located (reviewer text only; low-text pages 2,3,4,6,10,14,16,18,19,27,31 are chart slides).
points.catch_reason: Code-side drop, not a reading error.
points.better_check: Same as above: support check on the page, not on the quote.

points.wrong_point: Results block Revenue vs memory priors (Q2 'Revenue' = Total Income compared with revenue from ops, +247.8% YoY / +408.7% QoQ)
points.evidence: Deck: 'Total Income 2,575 1,867 38% 1,337 93%' and 'Interest and other Income 637'. Live block still shows revenue 1,935.17 vs prior 740.38 / 506.17 = +161% / +282% (changed from reviewer's 2,575 but still not like for like). Filing text is clean and carries the like-for-like +38% / +93%.
points.catch_reason: Priors come from memory/XBRL of another basis.
points.better_check: Reject growth > ~100% when the filing prints a different %; compare block YoY to the filing's own printed 38%.

points.wrong_point: deal_value: Marine Lines called an Rs 6,000 Cr ACQUISITION, SCALE signal '12% of market cap, 30% of net worth', HIGH impact score
points.evidence: p20: 'Marine Lines, Mumbai 1.10 ... Estimated booking value (INR Crores) 6,000 ... Business development ... Revenue Share - 86.4%'. 'Estimated booking value' is not a price paid. Live deal_value is still kind ACQUISITION, amount 6,000.
points.catch_reason: Clean text; semantic mis-typing. The score then inherits it in code.
points.better_check: Rule: a deal amount tagged ACQUISITION needs words like 'acquire/consideration/purchase price'; revenue-share projects and 'booking value' map to OTHER.

points.wrong_point: SCALE signal's net worth Rs 20,000 Cr (filing net worth 19,359)
points.evidence: Deck p~24: 'Networth (INR Cr) 19,359 19,505 19,156'. 20,000 is the BD guidance (reviewer; memory ref). Which input fed the signal could not be verified from the card.
points.catch_reason: Right number is in clean text; the signal took another value.
points.better_check: Compute net-worth ratios only from the balance-sheet fields (fundamentals.net_worth), not from memory guidance items.

points.wrong_point: quantified_impact 'H2 Pre-sales Potential' 40,589 Cr (32,000 launch value + 8,589 H1 sustenance)
points.evidence: p14: 'Bookings of INR 22,500-25,000 crores expected in H2'; launch value is ~32,000 (a different quantity); 8,589 is H1 sustenance sales. The card's check says VERIFIED because arithmetic is right.
points.catch_reason: Arithmetic verified, semantics wrong; filing states the answer.
points.better_check: Compare any 'H2 potential' result to the filing's own stated range; flag results outside it.

points.wrong_point: Call takeaway 'Construction and related outflow rose 42% YoY' (no YoY figure in the filing)
points.evidence: Quote 'Construction & related outflow -2,121 -4,365' (Q2 and H1); 42% is not in the text. Card's own grounding marks it verified:false ('42% is not in its quote').
points.catch_reason: Computed from mismatched columns; both engines read the same two numbers.
points.better_check: Publish gate: drop a takeaway that the grounder itself marked verified:false.

points.wrong_point: Cost of deposits 'rose to 7.40% from 6.42% a year ago'
points.evidence: p25 text layer: series come out as bare lines: 'Cost of Fund 6.53% 6.46% 6.42% 6.55% 6.55%', 'Cost of Borrowings 7.86% 7.34% 7.01% 7.17% 7.40%', and 'Cost of Deposits' appears AFTER the previous chart's numbers, then '6.37% 6.35% 6.33% 6.46% 6.43%'. Chart data: title/value adjacency is positional, so the writer attached the neighbouring series. OCR on the chart page may preserve the title above its bars (not run).
points.catch_reason: A layout-aware engine (OCR) might order title and series differently; if the two give different title-to-series mappings the check would fire. If both give the same adjacency, they agree and are both wrong.
points.better_check: Require the values to be taken as a labelled series with 5 quarter labels, and have the quote contain the title; the card's quote 'Cost of Deposits 7.40% Q2 FY26 6.42%' is not in the filing (grounder flagged 'quote not in the filing').

points.wrong_point: CASA 'moderated to 18.96% from 20.55%' as a YoY sentence (20.55% is Q3FY26; Q2FY26 was 21.17%)
points.evidence: p~19 series: '21.17% 20.55% 19.96% 19.41% 18.96%' under 'Q2 FY26 ... Q2 FY27'. Positions are clear; model took the second value as the prior year.
points.catch_reason: Both engines would give the same 5-number series; the pick was wrong.
points.better_check: Code: map the series to its quarter labels and derive YoY from the first and last; compare to the stated bps.

points.wrong_point: 'below target of 19.41%' (19.41% is the Q1FY27 ratio, not a target)
points.evidence: Same CASA series: 4th value is Q1FY27 = 19.41%.
points.catch_reason: Invented relationship from a neighbouring number.
points.better_check: Verify 'target/guidance' wording against a filing sentence containing 'target'.

points.wrong_point: Results block EBITDA 1,128.74 vs prev year 973.96 (+15.9%) and prev quarter 1,272.2: filing says 1,152.88 and 1,483.91 (-2.1% / -23.9%)
points.evidence: Text layer line: 'Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortisation (EBITDA) 1128.74 1483.91 1152.88 ...'. Live block shows priors 973.96 / 1272.2 (derived excluding other income 178.92 / 211.71). The pipeline's own grounder logged 'key number EBITDA: change -2.1% YoY removed'.
points.catch_reason: Right priors are on the same row as the current figure in clean text; wrong priors were built by code from XBRL.
points.better_check: Prefer the filing's own same-row comparatives; flag when current and prior EBITDA differ in definition (other income included); the grounder already computed -2.1% and the block should not disagree.

points.wrong_point: EBITDA margin 19.14% vs 20.46% prior year (mixed bases)
points.catch_reason: Same as above.
points.better_check: Recompute the margin from the same-row EBITDA and revenue.

points.wrong_point: Whole card: procedural audio link for the earnings call with no information; results card exists (nse-106826252)
points.evidence: One-page letter: 'audio link of the said call is uploaded ... The transcript ... will be uploaded in due course.' Card figures: none. Card is faithful but should not exist (relevance gate / event triage).
points.catch_reason: Nothing to disagree on; the filing was read perfectly.
points.better_check: Rule-based skip: one-page letters with a media link and no numbers under CONCALL_PRESENTATION, or an unchanged-content test vs the same-day results card.

points.wrong_point: Third card for the same Q2FY27 results the same evening (nse-106826851, nse-106826987)
points.evidence: Live card pack members: nse-106826982, nse-106827039, nse-106826988 (the pack did not include 106826851/106826987 as named by the reviewer). Press release matches the other cards ('Q2 revenue stood at 116 crores, up 5.7%').
points.catch_reason: Not an extraction issue; dedupe of same-event cards.
points.better_check: Dedupe by company+period+event: when a results card exists for that quarter, merge later filings in as follow-ups.

points.wrong_point: results block ebitda margin qoq_bps 281 / ebitda qoq 73.7% (Q2 company EBITDA vs Q1 XBRL-derived)
points.evidence: Press release: 'consolidated EBITDA was Rs 42 crores, margin 36.1%'; H1 EBITDA Rs 67 crores -> Q1 about 25 Cr. Live results block now shows ebitda {value 42.0} with no prior, so already changed (reviewed version not seen).
points.catch_reason: Bases differ between sources, not a reading issue.
points.better_check: Show a QoQ for a line only when both values share the basis; compare with H1 minus Q2.

points.wrong_point: Card as a whole is a duplicate of nse-106827008 (same PDF refiled)
points.evidence: SHA-256 of both URLs' PDFs is identical (ab4cb136...2b50; verified, also 4,573,836 bytes).
points.catch_reason: Not a reading issue.
points.better_check: Hash the PDF and skip the card when a published card exists for the same hash.

points.wrong_point: Notable change previous '39.06 Cr (Q2FY25)': the column is 30-09-2025 = Q2FY26
points.evidence: p2-p3 text: columns '30-09-2026 | 30-06-2026 | 30-09-2025 | ...'; consolidated 'Revenue From Operations 12,959.85 5,083.82 3,906.02'. Right column present with date headers; the model mislabelled the period (also unit: Lacs, card shows 129.60 Cr, which is right).
points.catch_reason: Column header text is clean.
points.better_check: Derive the period label from the column's date header in code; require label == mapped quarter.

points.wrong_point: rating_change block AA- -> BB- (notches -9) comparing CRISIL domestic with CareEdge Global foreign-currency rating
points.evidence: Filing: 'CareEdge Global Ratings has reaffirmed the long-term foreign currency rating ... at CareEdge BB-, while revising the outlook to Positive from Stable'. Live rating_change now has before=null, notches=null, so the block was fixed; the live score reason still says 'Rating moved 9 notches'.
points.catch_reason: The wrong 'before' came from memory, not from the filing.
points.better_check: Compare ratings only on the same agency AND scale (domestic vs international) and never when the filing says 'reaffirmed'.

points.wrong_point: Score reason 'Impact: Rating moved 9 notches' (impact HIGH)
points.evidence: Live score reasons still contain 'Impact: Rating moved 9 notches' and impact HIGH although rating_change.notches is now null (stale score).
points.catch_reason: Downstream of the false memory comparison.
points.better_check: Recompute the score after any change to the block; reject a notch claim when the filing text says 'reaffirmed'.

points.wrong_point: category_tag RIGHTS / event_type RIGHTS_ISSUE on a buyback letter of offer
points.evidence: Letter p1: 'Submission of Letter of Offer pertaining to buyback of not exceeding 87,50,000 ... through the tender offer'. Live card: category_tag RIGHTS, event_type RIGHTS_ISSUE. Unverified whether the tag came from a rule or the model.
points.catch_reason: Plain text says buyback; a classification error, not a reading error.
points.better_check: Keyword guard: 'buyback' + 'tender offer' in the filing forbids RIGHTS_ISSUE.

points.wrong_point: Headline reads as a new announcement; terms were already on the 17 Oct card (near-duplicate)
points.evidence: Live headline 'VRL Logistics to buy back 5% of shares at Rs 320 via tender offer'; the earlier card nse-106820959 is the reviewer's reference (not re-fetched).
points.catch_reason: Dedupe/novelty issue.
points.better_check: Compare with earlier card's deal_value (size, price); mark as follow-up with only the new fields.

points.wrong_point: Signal WATCH_RESOLVED 'KPI check partial: Tonnage growth ... results pending' on a buyback letter
points.evidence: Live signals: WATCH_RESOLVED w_d18c3975 'Tonnage growth'.
points.catch_reason: Memory watch-item matcher fired on an unrelated filing.
points.better_check: Resolve a watch only when the filing contains a figure for that KPI.
